This attack appears to be exploitable via parsing a crafted file.

CVE-2024-12133.title: A flaw in libtasn1 causes inefficient handling of specific certif ...
CVE-2024-12133.description: A flaw in libtasn1 causes inefficient handling of specific certificate data. When processing a large number of elements in a certificate, libtasn1 takes much longer than expected, which can slow down or even crash the system. This flaw allows an attacker to send a specially crafted certificate, causing a denial of service attack.
